ban.en: Italy banned nuclear power after Chernobyl, and confirmed that ban again after Fukushima, when 94% of voters rejected building new reactors .
ban.zh: 意大利在切尔诺贝利事故后禁止了核电，并在福岛事故后再次确认了这一禁令，当时94%的选民投票反对建造新反应堆。

ban.en: Italy banned nuclear power after Chernobyl, and confirmed that ban again after Fukushima, when 94% of voters rejected building new reactors .
ban.zh: 意大利在切尔诺贝利事故后禁止了核电，并在福岛事故后再次确认了这一禁令，当时94%的选民投票反对建造新反应堆。

battery.en: And while batteries are getting cheaper every year, storing enough electricity to keep a country running for days at a time is still a long way off .
battery.zh: 虽然电池每年都在降价，但要储存足够的电力让一个国家连续运转数天，依然遥不可及。

backbone.en: And increasingly, governments have concluded that nuclear and renewables need to work together, with nuclear providing the steady backbone that a renewable -heavy grid needs to actually function.
backbone.zh: 越来越多的政府得出结论：核能和可再生能源需要协同工作，由核能提供稳定的骨干支撑，以使依赖可再生能源的电网能够真正运转。

bacon.en: Items like meat, butter, bacon, sugar, eggs, and cheese were restricted.
bacon.zh: 肉类、黄油、培根、糖、鸡蛋和奶酪等物品受到限制。

bacon.en: For breakfast, you can try full English breakfasts: eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, and toast, sometimes black pudding as well.
bacon.zh: 早餐方面，你可以尝试英式全套早餐：鸡蛋、培根、香肠、焗豆、蘑菇、西红柿和吐司，有时还有黑布丁。
